name: Insulin, Regular, Human
description: Regular human insulin (e.g. Actrapid, Humulin R, Novolin R), the standard insulin for intravenous infusion in the ICU. RxNorm ingredient with all descendants.

versions.author: Gregor Lichtner
versions.message: Initial version: the RxNorm ingredient insulin, regular, human (1596977) with all descendants, following the other insulin concept sets (123-127). Regular human insulin had no concept set, although it is the insulin given by intravenous infusion in the ICU and QI03 (Feeding) depends on the insulin rate.
